title_en: United 737 Declares Double Emergency After Landing Gear Fails, Has Just 10 Minutes Of Fuel Left
title_zh: 联合航空 737 起落架故障后宣布双重紧急状态，燃油仅剩 10 分钟
summary: Crew declared an emergency after right main gear failed to deploy and fuel dwindled to under 12 minutes.
summary_zh: 右主起落架未能展开且燃油不足 12 分钟后，机组人员宣布进入紧急状态。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

A recent United Airlines flight from the Cayman Islands to Texas faced a double emergency onboard when the Boeing 737 MAX 9 had issues with its landing gear deploying. This then led to the burning of excess fuel, and the pilots identified that they had just 10 to 12 minutes of fuel left.

Pilots urgently coordinated with air traffic control at Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) to land the aircraft safely, with controllers working closely with the crew to bring the aircraft to the ground without catastrophe.

United Airlines Flight Has Landing Gear Issues, And Runs Short On Fuel

United flight 1854 is a scheduled twice-weekly service between Grand Cayman (GCM) and Houston. The service departed from Owen Roberts International, the main airport serving the British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean, on Sunday, October 25 at 4:28 PM, 17 minutes ahead of its usual departure time of 4:45 PM.

With a usual flight time of around three hours, flight data shows the service operated otherwise uneventfully for the majority of the nonstop flight to Houston, although once the aircraft began its descent into Houston , disaster struck when the crew was unable to successfully deploy the landing gear.

Pilots immediately notified the air traffic controllers at Houston, declaring an emergency due to the landing gear malfunction. Another passing aircraft also confirmed that the right landing gear remained up and had not successfully deployed.
Simple Flying reached out to United for comment, and the airline confirmed a total of 83 passengers were onboard, with a total of six crew. The airline also shared the below statement
United flight 1854 from Grand Cayman to Houston declared an emergency upon landing due to a mechanical indication. The plane landed safely, taxied normally and passengers deplaned at the gate.

In the recording of air traffic control and pilot communications as shared by theaviationcircle on Instagram , when the captain declared the emergency, he stated that there were '90 souls onboard', and that the 4.9 right main gear would not come down. The air traffic control confirmed that the flight would complete a low pass over Houston Intercontinental to verify the landing gear malfunction.

A passing aircraft was also able to confirm that the right main gear had not deployed; however, as the jet was still in the air, the crew on board the affected jet emphasized it was low on fuel and had just ten to 12 minutes of fuel left.

As the aircraft kept in close communication with control, the request was made for the jet to be met with both fire trucks and other emergency services. While in its final holding pattern, the right main gear finally deployed, permitting the United flight to finally land safely. Data from Simple Flying's Flight Tracker shows that the MAX 9 was able to finally land at 8:24 PM, with no reports of injury onboard. The plane was then met by first responders on the runway to ensure the aircraft was safe to continue its taxi to the terminal.
body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
最近，联合航空从开曼群岛飞往德克萨斯州的一架航班在波音 737 MAX 9 起落架展开时出现问题，机上面临双重紧急情况。这导致了多余燃料的燃烧，飞行员发现他们只剩下 10 到 12 分钟的燃料了。

联合航空航班起落架出现问题且燃油不足
美联航 1854 航班是往返于大开曼岛 (GCM) 和休斯顿之间的定期航班，每周两班。该航班于 10 月 25 日（星期日）下午 4:28 从欧文·罗伯茨国际机场（服务于加勒比海英国海外领土的主要机场）出发，比通常的下午 4:45 出发时间提前 17 分钟。
通常的飞行时间约为三个小时，飞行数据显示，在飞往休斯顿的直飞航班的大部分时间里，该服务运行顺利，尽管飞机开始降落到休斯顿后，机组人员无法成功展开起落架，灾难发生了。
飞行员立即通知休斯敦的空中交通管制员，宣布由于起落架故障进入紧急状态。另一架经过的飞机也证实右起落架仍处于升起状态，并未成功展开。
Simple Flying联系美联航请其置评，该航空公司确认机上共有 83 名乘客，共有 6 名机组人员。该航空公司还发表了以下声明
从大开曼岛飞往休斯顿的美联航 1854 号航班在着陆时因机械指示而宣布进入紧急状态。飞机安全着陆，滑行正常，乘客在登机口下机。
在 Instagram 上的航空界分享的空中交通管制和飞行员通讯记录中，机长宣布紧急状态时表示，“机上有 90 人”，并且 4.9 右侧主起落架不会降落。空中交通管制证实，该航班将低空飞过休斯敦洲际机场，以验证起落架故障。
一架经过的飞机也能够确认右侧主起落架尚未展开；然而，由于飞机仍在空中，受影响飞机上的机组人员强调飞机燃油不足，仅剩 10 到 12 分钟的燃油。
由于飞机与控制中心保持密切联系，因此要求消防车和其他紧急服务人员为飞机提供服务。在最后的等待模式中，正确的主起落架最终展开，使美联航航班最终安全着陆。 Simple Flying 飞行跟踪器的数据显示，MAX 9 最终于晚上 8 点 24 分着陆，没有机上受伤的报告。随后，急救人员在跑道上与飞机会合，以确保飞机能够安全地继续滑行至航站楼。

title_en: Southwest Launches 11 New Nonstop Routes From Major City: See Full List Now
title_zh: 西南航空推出 11 条从主要城市出发的新直达航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: Eight are domestic and three are international. Find out more here!
summary_zh: 八个是国内的，三个是国际的。在这里了解更多！
body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

Las Vegas has played a critical role in Southwest Airlines' network for many years. 30 years ago, for example, the US Department of Transportation (DOT) shows that it had the carrier's second-highest passenger volume, behind Phoenix (really). 20 years ago, it was first, but was back in the second spot in 2025, behind Denver.

The significance of Las Vegas' Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) is for multiple reasons. Obviously, they include being a major city and a world-renowned tourist destination and conference location. But it is also influenced by the significance of connecting traffic, with 35% of its passengers transiting on another flight there . These things, and much more, contribute to LAS welcoming 11 new routes: eight domestic and three international .
Southwest's Eight New Domestic Routes From Las Vegas

The carrier's schedule from LAS was explored using Cirium Diio data. This looked at everywhere served in 2025, and then compared the network to what is operating in 2026 or which is scheduled to commence in the remainder of the year through June 2027 . Things will inevitably change, so treat it for what it is: a snapshot as of October 26.
No: Santa Rosa is a brand-new destination in Southwest's overall network in 2026
Yes: American Airlines and Frontier (only scheduled until November 2026)

The most notable addition was Anchorage International Airport (ANC), with Alaska welcoming the self-described hybrid carrier for the first time in 2026. It operates from both LAS and Denver. DOT data for May to July 2026 shows that 18,426 passengers were transported to/from LAS, but the load factor was just 67.9%. Even July was only marginally better (71.9%), although fare data is unavailable. This initial performance explains why the route will commence nearly three weeks later in 2027.

Then There Are These Three International Routes

2026 was historical for various reasons, including being the first time that Southwest flew internationally from LAS. Interestingly, not even the ever-popular Cancun, served through Cancun International Airport (CUN), was served by another carrier when Southwest launched flights in June. However, it has had various operators over the years. For example, Volaris operated in 2014/2015, Frontier did so in 2018/2019, and JetBlue attempted to make the market work in 2021/2022.
Yes: Alaska Airlines operated until April 2026. It was unserved thereafter
Yes: Alaska Airlines operated until February 2026. It was unserved thereafter

None of the carriers which flew between LAS and CUN lasted for long. Things might be a little easier for Southwest. It'll benefit from its huge brand name in Sin City and its considerable network from LAS. It'll easily be able to supplement the local LAS-CUN traffic with transfer passengers. However, this approach did not work overly well for the first season of LAS-ANC. Will CUN be different?

Southwest has removed two routes from its LAS network in 2026, with no destination currently down for the same fate in 2027. Of course, things could change. In early 2026, the carrier revealed service from Sin City to San Jose, Costa Rica. It was set to be Southwest's longest international operation and the airline's first overnight international route . However, the link was pulled in July before the first flight took off .
body_zh: 詹姆斯与路线开发息息相关。詹姆斯曾就读于拉夫堡大学和克兰菲尔德大学航空运输管理专业，拥有航空公司战略和经济学博士学位。 James 曾任伦敦卢顿机场市场机会分析师和 anna.aero 首席分析师。他向本科生和研究生教授航空公司战略和经济学五年，并与多家航空公司在航线和市场情报项目上密切合作。他居住在英国伦敦附近。
多年来，拉斯维加斯在西南航空的网络中发挥着关键作用。例如，30 年前，美国交通部 (DOT) 显示，该航空公司的客运量位居第二，仅次于菲尼克斯航空公司（确实如此）。 20 年前，它是第一，但到 2025 年又回到第二位，落后于丹佛。
拉斯维加斯哈利里德国际机场 (LAS) 的重要性有多种原因。显然，它们包括成为一个主要城市以及世界著名的旅游目的地和会议地点。但它也受到中转交通重要性的影响，35%的乘客在那里转乘另一趟航班。这些以及更多因素促使 LAS 迎来 11 条新航线：8 条国内航线和 3 条国际航线。

使用 Cirium Diio 数据探索了来自 LAS 的航空公司的航班时刻表。该研究考察了 2025 年提供服务的所有地方，然后将该网络与 2026 年运营的网络或计划在今年剩余时间（截至 2027 年 6 月）开始运行的网络进行比较。事情不可避免地会发生变化，因此请按其本来面目对待它：截至 10 月 26 日的快照。

是：美国航空 (American Airlines) 和边疆航空 (Frontier)（仅计划到 2026 年 11 月）

最引人注目的新增项目是安克雷奇国际机场 (ANC)，阿拉斯加将于 2026 年首次迎来这家自称为混合型航空公司的机场。该机场在洛杉矶国际机场和丹佛均有航班运营。 DOT 2026 年 5 月至 7 月的数据显示，往返 LAS 的乘客数量为 18,426 人次，但客座率仅为 67.9%。尽管无法获得票价数据，但即使是 7 月份，也只是略微好一些（71.9%）。这一初步表现解释了为什么该航线将在近三周后的 2027 年开通。

那么就有这3条国际航线

由于多种原因，2026 年是历史性的一年，其中包括西南航空首次从洛杉矶国际机场运营国际航班。 Interestingly, not even the ever-popular Cancun, served through Cancun International Airport (CUN), was served by another carrier when Southwest launched flights in June.然而，多年来它有不同的运营商。例如，Volaris 于 2014/2015 年运营，Frontier 于 2018/2019 年运营，而 JetBlue 则试图在 2021/2022 年让市场发挥作用。
是：阿拉斯加航空公司运营至2026年4月。此后未送达
是：阿拉斯加航空运营至 2026 年 2 月。此后不再提供服务
在 LAS 和 CUN 之间飞行的航空公司都没有能够持续很长时间。对于西南航空来说，事情可能会容易一些。它将受益于其在罪恶之城的巨大品牌知名度和来自 LAS 的庞大网络。它将能够轻松补充当地 LAS-CUN 的中转乘客交通。然而，这种方法在 LAS-ANC 的第一季中效果不佳。 CUN会有所不同吗？
西南航空已于 2026 年从其 LAS 网络中删除了两条航线，目前没有目的地在 2027 年遭受同样的命运。当然，情况可能会发生变化。 2026 年初，该航空公司宣布开通从罪恶之城飞往哥斯达黎加圣何塞的航班。这将是西南航空最长的国际航线，也是该航空公司的第一条隔夜国际航线。然而，该链接在 7 月首个航班起飞前被取消。

title_en: Premium Push: The US Airlines Introducing First Class Cabins In 2027
title_zh: 推动高端舱位：全美航空将于 2027 年推出头等舱
summary: Budget airlines are also looking to move upmarket.
summary_zh: 廉价航空公司也在寻求进军高端市场。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

The general status quo in the US (and largely within the global airline industry) is that the low-cost carrier business model involves selling only economy seats, while premium cabins are reserved for full-service airlines. In the US, however, there have been some interesting developments, as domestic first class cabins have been announced by Allegiant Air and Frontier to arrive in 2027.

Meanwhile, JetBlue will introduce its own first class cabin in December 2026. These carriers are not the first airlines in the United States to do so either. The budget airline model is traditionally centered around cost-cutting, volume, and efficiency. Onboard, this means tight seats in an all-economy layout.

Premium seats earn significantly more revenue, but budget airlines usually don't try to charge such high fare premiums when the seats take up so much floor space. In the US, however, low-cost carriers have generally struggled post-COVID as demand for premium seats continues to rise, so we're seeing more low-cost premium products enter the market.

Traditionally, domestic first class was sold by American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, and United Airlines, along with their merger partners in the past and Hawaiian Airlines. In addition, AirTran and Alaska Airlines long sold domestic first class, although Alaska has become more of a hybrid carrier than a low-cost airline, and the same was also true of Virgin America.

In 2007, meanwhile, Spirit Airlines introduced 'Big Front Seat', which essentially gave passengers the same onboard experience as before but with a large recliner . In 2014, JetBlue introduced a unique product as it began selling 'Mint', a highly competitive lie-flat business class seat for premium transcontinental routes, and this has even been extended to other markets in North America.

After Southwest Airlines acquired AirTran in 2010 and Alaska Airlines acquired Virgin America in 2016, passengers seeking a domestic premium cabin could fly American, Delta, United, Alaska, Hawaiian, or Spirit, and JetBlue Mint was also available on select routes. This was the status quo leading up to COVID, while Allegiant Air, Frontier, Southwest Airlines, and Sun Country only sold economy.

Post-COVID, Breeze Airways and Avelo Airlines launched operations with all-economy planes, but then in 2022, Breeze started flying new Airbus A220s with first class. Frontier began selling extra-legroom economy seats with a blocked middle seat in 2024, while Southwest began selling extra-legroom seats in January 2026 . Meanwhile, Spirit Airlines went out of business in May.

Frontier's launch of 'UpFront Plus' seating in early 2024 was somewhat unexpected. The airline had not offered premium seating options at the time, and the product more closely resembles intra-European business class than US seating options. However, this was mainly a stopgap solution, as Frontier announced later that year that it would also introduce a new first class product to better compete for premium passengers.

Years after being announced, it will finally launch in 2027. Frontier Airlines selected the Geven Comoda platform, which is similar to the large recliner seats offered by other US airlines for first class, and will be configured four-abreast while offering more legroom. In addition, Frontier will also install power ports in these seats, although it's unclear what types will be available.

One notable omission, however, is recline, as these seats will instead be 'pre-reclined'. In terms of the soft product, first class tickets don't include complimentary drinks or snacks, so passengers pay only for the seat. It's believed that Frontier will begin retrofitting planes very soon, and there will be two rows for a total of eight seats per aircraft.

Initially, these seats will be sold as Upfront Plus until early March 2027, which is when the airline expects to complete retrofitting its fleet and officially launch the product. Beyond the seat, Frontier is also retrofitting Starlink WiFi, which is almost as impactful as the new first class seats for passengers, given that its aircraft currently lack any kind of WiFi system.

Allegiant Air formerly offered the 'Giant Seat' on its Boeing 757-200 fleet from 2014 to 2017, but this was a limited product that was only present on a handful of aircraft. In recent years, the airline has found success with its extra-legroom seats, and in July 2026, Allegiant Air formally announced that it would introduce a new 'Allegiant First' cabin in March 2027, the same month when Frontier will introduce first class.

Tickets went on sale in August, so you can buy an Allegiant First ticket now. The seat mode isn't confirmed, but the airline has said passengers can expect a seat pitch of 37 inches (93.98 centimeters), five inches (12.7 cm) of recline, an adjustable headrest, and an extendable calf rest.

In addition, customers will receive complimentary beverages, while Allways Rewards Visa cardholders get additional beverage options. Passengers also receive priority airport treatment, board early, and receive enhanced onboard service. Allegiant plans to install eight seats on the 737 MAX 200, and the cabin will be available on newly delivered aircraft, with Allegiant planning an initial fleet of 23 aircraft.

Initially, the airline also plans to offer the cabin mainly out of Punta Gorda Airport (PGD) in Southwest Florida. With limited network deployment and a relatively small subfleet, this won't be a widespread product initially, but Allegiant appears to have created a competitive offering while still positioning it as a lower-cost alternative to premium products offered by the legacies.

JetBlue has long offered Mint on a select number of Airbus A321-200s, while its second-generation Mint suites are offered on an A321neo subfleet and on all A321LRs, which operate transatlantic services. In addition, JetBlue has traditionally offered a large number of what are now named 'EvenMore' extra legroom seats.

However, despite offering a leading business class and economy product, along with its presence in major business markets, JetBlue has never offered a standard domestic first class until now. After years of rumors, JetBlue formally announced 'BlueFirst' in September 2026. This complements Mint and is meant for essentially all markets that don't justify a lie-flat seat.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
美国（主要是全球航空业）的普遍现状是，低成本航空公司的商业模式仅销售经济舱座位，而高级舱位则保留给提供全方位服务的航空公司。然而，在美国，出现了一些有趣的发展，忠实航空和边疆航空宣布将于 2027 年推出国内头等舱。
与此同时，捷蓝航空将于 2026 年 12 月推出自己的头等舱。这些航空公司也不是美国第一家这样做的航空公司。廉价航空公司模式传统上以削减成本、数量和效率为中心。在机上，这意味着全经济舱布局中的座位紧张。
高级座位可以赚取更多的收入，但廉价航空公司通常不会在座位占用如此多的地板空间时收取如此高的票价溢价。然而，在美国，随着对高级座位的需求持续上升，低成本航空公司在新冠疫情后普遍陷入困境，因此我们看到更多低成本的高级产品进入市场。
传统上，国内头等舱由美国航空、达美航空和联合航空及其过去的合并伙伴夏威夷航空出售。此外，穿越航空和阿拉斯加航空长期销售国内头等舱，尽管阿拉斯加航空已成为一家混合航空公司而不是一家低成本航空公司，维珍美国航空也是如此。
与此同时，精神航空在 2007 年推出了“大前座”，本质上为乘客提供了与以前相同的机上体验，但配备了大躺椅。 2014年，捷蓝航空推出了一款独特的产品，开始销售“Mint”，这是一种竞争激烈的平躺式商务舱座椅，适用于优质横贯大陆航线，并且该产品甚至已扩展到北美其他市场。
西南航空于 2010 年收购穿越航空，阿拉斯加航空于 2016 年收购维珍美国航空后，寻求国内高级舱位的乘客可以乘坐美国航空、达美航空、联合航空、阿拉斯加航空、夏威夷航空或精神航空，捷蓝薄荷航空也在部分航线上提供服务。这就是新冠疫情爆发前的现状，而忠实航空、边疆航空、西南航空和太阳国航空只出售经济舱。
新冠疫情过后，微风航空 (Breeze Airways) 和阿维洛航空 (Avelo Airlines) 开始运营全经济舱飞机，但在 2022 年，微风航空 (Breeze Airways) 开始运营全新空客 A220 头等舱。边疆航空于 2024 年开始销售加宽中间座位的经济舱座位，而西南航空则于 2026 年 1 月开始销售加长腿部空间的座位。与此同时，精神航空于五月倒闭。
Frontier 在 2024 年初推出“UpFront Plus”座椅有点出乎意料。该航空公司当时尚未提供高级座位选择，而且该产品更类似于欧洲内部的商务舱，而不是美国的座位选择。然而，这主要是一个权宜之计，因为当年晚些时候，Frontier 宣布还将推出新的头等舱产品，以更好地争夺优质乘客。
追踪天空最有趣的时刻，直播
等待、改航和稀有飞机，一目了然。免费，无需注册。
宣布多年后，该座椅最终将于 2027 年推出。边疆航空选择了 Geven Comoda 平台，该平台类似于其他美国航空公司为头等舱提供的大躺椅，并将配置为四人并排，同时提供更多的腿部空间。此外，Frontier 还将在这些座椅上安装电源端口，不过目前还不清楚会提供哪些类型。
然而，一个值得注意的遗漏是倾斜，因为这些座椅将被“预先倾斜”。在软产品方面，头等舱机票不包含免费饮料或小吃，因此乘客只需支付座位费用。相信Frontier很快就会开始改装飞机，每架飞机将有两排，总共八个座位。
最初，这些座椅将作为 Upfront Plus 出售，直至 2027 年 3 月上旬，该航空公司预计届时将完成其机队改造并正式推出该产品。除了座椅之外，Frontier 还改装了 Starlink WiFi，鉴于该公司的飞机目前缺乏任何类型的 WiFi 系统，这对乘客来说几乎与新的头等舱座椅一样有影响力。
忠诚航空曾于 2014 年至 2017 年间在其波音 757-200 机队上提供“巨型座椅”，但这是一款限量产品，仅在少数飞机上配备。近年来，该航空公司凭借加宽座椅取得了成功，2026 年 7 月，忠诚航空正式宣布将于 2027 年 3 月推出新的“忠诚头等舱”客舱，同月边疆航空将推出头等舱。
门票已于 8 月开始销售，因此您现在就可以购买 Allegiant First 门票。座椅模式尚未确定，但航空公司表示，乘客可以享受 37 英寸（93.98 厘米）的座椅间距、5 英寸（12.7 厘米）的倾斜度、可调节的头枕和可伸缩的小腿托。
此外，客户还将获得免费饮料，而 Allways Rewards Visa 持卡人还可获得额外的饮料选择。乘客还可享受优先机场待遇、提早登机并享受增强的机上服务。 Allegiant 计划在 737 MAX 200 上安装 8 个座位，新交付的飞机上也将配备客舱，Allegiant 计划的初始机队由 23 架飞机组成。
最初，该航空公司还计划主要在佛罗里达州西南部的蓬塔戈尔达机场 (PGD) 提供客舱。由于网络部署有限且子机群相对较小，该产品最初不会成为广泛使用的产品，但 Allegiant 似乎已经创建了一种具有竞争力的产品，同时仍将其定位为传统公司提供的优质产品的低成本替代品。
捷蓝航空长期以来一直在部分空客 A321-200 上提供 Mint 套件，而其第二代 Mint 套件则在 A321neo 子机队和所有运营跨大西洋航班的 A321LR 上提供。此外，捷蓝航空传统上还提供大量现在被称为“EvenMore”的额外腿部空间座位。
然而，尽管捷蓝航空提供领先的商务舱和经济舱产品，并在主要商务市场占有一席之地，但迄今为止从未提供过标准的国内头等舱。经过多年的传闻，捷蓝航空于 2026 年 9 月正式宣布推出“BlueFirst”。这对 Mint 来说是一个补充，适用于基本上所有不适合平躺座椅的市场。

title_en: How A Single Maintenance Issue Can Pose A Real Bottleneck To Alaska Airlines' 5-Jet Transatlantic Operation
title_zh: 单一维护问题如何对阿拉斯加航空的 5 架喷气式飞机跨大西洋运营构成真正的瓶颈
summary: The fragility of a long-haul fleet that is just beginning to stretch its wings.
summary_zh: 刚刚开始展翅飞翔的长途机队的脆弱性。
body_en: How A Single Maintenance Issue Can Pose A Real Bottleneck To Alaska Airlines' 5-Jet Transatlantic Operation

Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

Alaska Airlines pushed ahead with its plans to become an international carrier following its merger with Hawaiian Airlines that wrapped up in 2024. The introduction of its first Boeing 787 Dreamliners has greatly expanded its long haul reach beyond what started with the handful of Airbus A330 widebodies from Honolulu. The five examples of 787s on the flight line now cover Rome, London, Seoul, and Tokyo in addition to Hawaii service.

This twin-aisle cadre has started an exciting period of growth and change for the Alaska Air Group. However, its small numbers have already shown how vulnerable the new international network is. On July 19, one of them turned around over England and never completed its crossing. The airline had no aircraft waiting to take its place.

When Alaska launched Rome in the spring, executives already said the carrier needed all five Dreamliners plus a spare it did not own to fly its full summer schedule , according to Business Traveller. The absence of a spare is exactly what made the midsummer breakdown a minor crisis instead of an unscheduled maintenance call. Relief is on the way, because Alaska has now ordered 17 Dreamliners in total with plans for at least 12 long-haul destinations from Seattle by 2030.

The reason the current 787 fleet is so small is that it began as an upgrade order for a smaller airline with much more limited intentions. Hawaiian Airlines, the original commitment, went and swapped its A330neo order for Boeing, but Alaska inherited the delivered jets through its merger. By January, the jets that were ready to fly were assigned to long-haul routes, and Alaska exercised every remaining 787 option under the deal.

That brought the group's total to 17 aircraft, including five larger variants, the 787-10. Still, by splitting its long-haul network across two entirely different aircraft manufacturers, Alaska is introducing dual-fleet friction on the flightline. Currently, its transatlantic operation only flies 787s, but in the Pacific, the Legacy A330-200 Hawaiian widebodies are flying alongside the newer 787s that Alaska has introduced. Alaska is also building this network against rivals that have more aircraft to spare.

Alaska wants at least 12 long-haul destinations from Seattle by 2030 , according to Airways. The international expansion has forced the carrier into a direct, head-to-head overseas battle against established global titans. While Alaska is aggressively scaling its long-haul base at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA), it faces a daunting reality. Almost every single seat it books through next summer is on a route where Delta Air Lines already offers nonstop competition.

The ability of its rivals to make countermoves was illustrated when Delta duplicated the inaugural Alaska transatlantic itinerary by adding its own nonstop flights to Rome Airport (FCO) from SeaTac. As one of the largest air carriers in the world, DAL can easily replace the A330neo it is flying head to head with Alaska should it be grounded without minimal schedule disruption. If Alaska falters, its competitors are ready to pounce.

Flight AS181 left Rome's Fiumicino Airport in the late afternoon of July 19 , operated by 787 tail number N780HA. About two hours later, over southeastern England, the crew abandoned the crossing and turned back. The pilots declared a general emergency and then dumped fuel to reduce its weight and landed back at FCO roughly five and a half hours after departure.

According to Aero Corner, the flight crew detected abnormal engine vibrations from the General Electric GEnx engines . There were no injuries to the passengers or crew. After an engineering evaluation on the ground, Alaska determined the aircraft required additional maintenance and canceled the original flight, arranging alternate accommodations for the passengers.

The aircraft remained grounded in Rome for approximately 18 hours for inspections and repairs. It departed the following day under the special flight number AS9281, arriving in Seattle with a cumulative delay of approximately 24 hours , according to the Aviation Herald. The real-world scenario of Flight AS181 on July 19 perfectly demonstrates how a single widebody diversion exposes severe structural bottlenecks within a highly constrained micro-fleet.

When N780HA turned back to Rome and was grounded for inspection, there were no backup aircraft available in Seattle or Europe to take its place. Because the scheduled buffer times between international arrivals and departures are minimal, a 24-hour grounding doesn't just affect the stranded passengers in Rome; it triggers a domino effect across the whole network.

When one of the precious few Alaska 787s is stuck on the field for a day, the next flight it was scheduled to fly out of Seattle must either be severely delayed or canceled entirely. With 20% of the active long-haul fleet instantly knocked offline by one issue on N780HA, the airline is forced to choose which destination to cancel next, creating an immediate, unavoidable capacity bottleneck.

The Big Three of Delta, American, and United Airlines have super-sized fleets that hover around a thousand airframes in any given tally. That allows them to have aircraft that are unassigned as 'hot spares' parked at various mega hubs around the world, which can step in if one plane breaks down. Alaska cannot afford to let a multi-million-dollar widebody sit idle. Every aircraft is booked on tight, back-to-back rotations.

Daily service is the first reason the calculus is so unforgiving. A single Dreamliner cannot fly a daily round trip to a transatlantic destination from Seattle. Each crossing takes most of a working day and the aircraft also needs time on the ground at both ends. Every daily route therefore needs at least two jets.

Rome and London together would consume at least four of the five Dreamliners, based on the published schedules, which leaves one aircraft to supplement the A330s serving Seoul, Tokyo and Honolulu. On the other hand, this seasonal rotation does help alleviate some of this pressure.

Rome flights run only through the busy months. Still, that approach only shifts risk into a calendar window instead of eliminating it. If a jet fails inside the peak demand, as N780HA did, no calendar trick can create a replacement, and Alaska has to reshuffle what few airframes it has.
Relief Arrives Slowly While The Retrofit Season Tightens Things
body_zh: 单一维护问题如何对阿拉斯加航空的 5 架喷气式飞机跨大西洋运营构成真正的瓶颈
卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
阿拉斯加航空于 2024 年与夏威夷航空合并后，继续推进其成为国际航空公司的计划。首架波音 787 梦想客机的推出极大地扩大了其长途航线覆盖范围，超越了最初从檀香山起飞的几架空客 A330 宽体客机。除夏威夷航线外，航线上的 5 架 787 飞机目前还覆盖罗马、伦敦、首尔和东京。
这支双通道干部队伍为阿拉斯加航空集团开启了一个激动人心的成长和变革时期。然而，其数量之少已经表明新的国际网络是多么脆弱。 7月19日，其中一艘在英格兰上空掉头，但从未完成穿越。该航空公司没有飞机等待取代。
据《商务旅行者》报道，当阿拉斯加航空公司于春季推出罗马航线时，高管们已经表示，该航空公司需要全部五架梦想飞机以及一架其不拥有的备用飞机来完成整个夏季的飞行。正是由于缺乏备用设备，仲夏故障才成为一场小危机，而不是一次计划外的维护呼叫。救援即将到来，因为阿拉斯加现已总共订购了 17 架梦想飞机，并计划到 2030 年从西雅图飞往至少 12 个长途目的地。
当前 787 机队之所以如此之小，是因为它最初是为一家规模较小的航空公司提供的升级订单，其意图更为有限。最初的承诺夏威夷航空将其 A330neo 订单换成了波音公司，但阿拉斯加航空通过合并继承了已交付的飞机。到 1 月份，准备飞行的喷气式飞机被分配到长途航线，阿拉斯加航空行使了协议中剩余的 787 飞机的所有选择权。
这使得该集团的飞机总数达到 17 架，其中包括五架较大的型号 787-10。尽管如此，通过将其长途网络分散到两个完全不同的飞机制造商，阿拉斯加正在航线上引入双机队摩擦。目前，其跨大西洋航线仅运营 787 飞机，但在太平洋地区，传统 A330-200 夏威夷宽体客机与阿拉斯加引进的新型 787 飞机一起飞行。阿拉斯加也在建立这个网络，以对抗拥有更多备用飞机的竞争对手。
据航空公司称，阿拉斯加希望到 2030 年至少有 12 个从西雅图出发的长途目的地。国际扩张迫使该航空公司与国际巨头进行直接的、正面的海外竞争。虽然阿拉斯加正在积极扩大其西雅图-塔科马国际机场 (SEA) 的长途基地，但它面临着令人畏惧的现实。到明年夏天为止，它预订的几乎所有座位都位于达美航空已经提供不间断竞争的航线上。
当达美航空通过增加从西塔科飞往罗马机场 (FCO) 的直飞航班来复制首个阿拉斯加跨大西洋航线时，就证明了其竞争对手采取反击的能力。作为世界上最大的航空公司之一，如果 A330neo 与阿拉斯加飞机停飞，DAL 可以轻松更换该机型，而不会造成航班计划中断。如果阿拉斯加步履蹒跚，它的竞争对手就会准备出击。
AS181 航班于 7 月 19 日下午晚些时候离开罗马菲乌米奇诺机场，由 787 机尾号 N780HA 运营。大约两小时后，在英格兰东南部上空，机组人员放弃了渡口并折返。飞行员宣布进入紧急状态，然后倾倒燃油以减轻重量，并在起飞后大约五个半小时返回 FCO。
据 Aero Corner 报道，机组人员检测到通用电气 GEnx 发动机出现异常振动。乘客或机组人员均未受伤。经过地面工程评估后，阿拉斯加确定飞机需要额外维护，并取消了原定航班，为乘客安排了替代住宿。
该飞机在罗马停飞约 18 小时以进行检查和维修。据《航空先驱报》报道，该航班次日起飞，特殊航班号为 AS9281，抵达西雅图，累计延误约 24 小时。 7 月 19 日 AS181 航班的真实场景完美地展示了单次宽体改航如何暴露高度受限的微型机队中严重的结构瓶颈。
当 N780HA 返回罗马并停飞接受检查时，西雅图或欧洲没有备用飞机可以替代它。由于国际航班到达和出发之间的预定缓冲时间很短，因此 24 小时停飞不仅会影响滞留在罗马的乘客，还会影响滞留的乘客。它会引发整个网络的多米诺骨牌效应。
当一架珍贵的阿拉斯加 787 飞机在机场滞留一天时，它原定从西雅图起飞的下一个航班要么严重延误，要么完全取消。由于 N780HA 的一个问题，20% 的活跃长途机队立即停飞，该航空公司被迫选择下一个取消哪个目的地，从而立即造成了不可避免的运力瓶颈。
达美航空、美国航空和联合航空三巨头拥有超大规模的机队，在任何给定的统计中，其机身数量都在一千架左右。这使得他们能够将未指定为“热备件”的飞机停放在世界各地的各个大型枢纽，如果一架飞机发生故障，这些飞机可以介入。阿拉斯加不能让价值数百万美元的宽体飞机闲置。每架飞机的预订都是紧密的、连续的轮换。
日常服务是微积分如此无情的第一个原因。单架梦想飞机无法执行从西雅图飞往跨大西洋目的地的每日往返航班。每次穿越都需要一个工作日的大部分时间，飞机还需要在两端地面停留的时间。因此，每条每日航线至少需要两架飞机。
根据公布的时间表，罗马和伦敦总共将消耗五架梦想飞机中的至少四架，从而留下一架飞机来补充服务于首尔、东京和檀香山的 A330 飞机。另一方面，这种季节性轮换确实有助于缓解一些压力。
罗马航班仅在繁忙月份运行。尽管如此，这种方法只是将风险转移到一个日历窗口中，而不是消除它。如果一架喷气式飞机在高峰需求期间出现故障，就像 N780HA 那样，任何日历技巧都无法创造替代品，阿拉斯加必须重新调整其仅有的几架机身。
救济缓慢到来，而改造季节使情况变得紧张

title_en: UPS Replaced Its McDonnell MD-11s With 18 Boeing 767Fs That Carry Roughly 65,000 Pounds Less Cargo Each
title_zh: UPS 用 18 架波音 767F 取代了 McDonnell MD-11，每架运输的货物重量减少了约 65,000 磅
summary: Why USP ditched every one of its trijets for a Boeing twin.
summary_zh: 为什么 USP 抛弃了所有的三引擎飞机而选择了波音的双胞胎飞机。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

In January, UPS Airlines announced that it would retire its entire fleet of 27 McDonnell Douglas MD-11 widebody cargo jets to be replaced by the newer Boeing 767-300F . The decision was made in the aftermath of the crash at Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport (SDF) in November 2025 that took the lives of the air crew as well as bystanders on the ground. The safety of flight was certainly a primary concern, yet the final decision regarding the aging trijets was based on business.

The investigation of UPS flight 2976 revealed a critical failure of the left-wing engine pylon that would have required extensive non-destructive testing of the remaining jets in the fleet, which left UPS without more than two dozen planes in the meantime. Unlike FedEx, which has returned its examples to service, UPS wrote off the entire fleet of MD-11s at a loss of nearly $140 million. Bringing the MD-11s back would arguably have lost nearly as much money due to months of downtime.

Then there was the added risk of discovering more faults and scrapping airframes anyway. However, the more modern 767 carries a considerably lower total weight and smaller overall volume in payload than the older trijet. Yet, in the present air freight market of the post-COVID-19 eCommerce boom, the 767's superior fuel efficiency outweighs both of those disadvantages. Trading 30% payload for 35% better fuel efficiency will make the emergency fleet reorganization an investment in the future in more ways than one.

While the heavy MD-11 trijet was built for massive intercontinental payloads , the 767 makes it vastly superior for high-volume, low-density cargo thanks to its fuel-saving design features. The core reason the 767 dominates today's air freight market comes down to cargo density. In the current era dominated by e-commerce, almost all the packages packed in the fuselage are very lightweight despite their volume.

The MD-11F offers roughly 25% more volume than the 767-300F, but it requires three engines and a significantly higher fuel burn at every phase of flight just to get from point A to point B. The 767 cargo variant boasts a 35% lower fuel consumption than the older trijet. That figure alone has been enough to make it the 'champion' of express air shipping in the post-COVID-19 Marketplace.

The 767 also boasts near-perfect mechanical reliability and a streamlined maintenance program thanks to more modern technology, ensuring aircraft spend less time in the hangar and more time in the air. E-commerce requires near-perfect dispatch reliability to meet delivery guarantees.

Additionally, the smaller twinjet is quieter and requires a smaller footprint at any given airfield. This allows operators like UPS, FedEx, and Amazon Prime Air to fly the 767 into smaller airports closer to end-consumers, bypassing congested international mega-hubs.

Express freight behaves differently from bulk cargo. Packages tend to fill up cabin space before they reach a jet's weight limit, so a freighter's container positions often decide how much it carries rather than its weight rating. This is where one of the notable similarities between the two jets severely undercuts the payload advantage of the MD-11 once again. That is the nearly equal size of the two cargo planes' main deck areas.

Despite being a substantially larger aircraft, the MD-11 only carries two more pallets than the 767 for a total of 26 compared to the twinjet's 24 maximum. Losing just two pallet positions represents a minimal volume sacrifice for express logistics operators. The minor reduction in floor space is completely eclipsed by the 767's superior efficiency.
3 High-Bypass Turbofans (GE CF6-80C2 or PW4000)
2 High-Bypass Turbofans (GE CF6-80C2 or PW4000)
~2,200 to 2,400 US gallons (~8,300 to 9,100 liters)
~1,500 to 1,600 US gallons (~5,700 to 6,000 liters)

E-commerce packages consist largely of lightweight goods, protective bubble wrap, and oversized cardboard boxes. Because this type of freight lacks density, an aircraft completely fills its physical cabin space, known as 'cubing out,' long before the weight of the cargo approaches a jet's limit. Loading an MD-11F with light e-commerce parcels means carrying empty, unutilized weight capacity while paying a massive fuel and maintenance penalty for a third engine.

The economic case for a leaner aircraft footprint has been further bolstered by a universal cooling of global shipping volumes and cargo network downsizing in 2025. Following a multi-year post-pandemic boom, global e-commerce demand began to contract, forcing mega-carriers to reset their logistics footprints. UPS implemented a sweeping network reorganization, intentionally moving to reduce its daily Amazon parcel volume by over 50% through this year.

UPS Flight 2976 was an MD-11 freighter bound for Honolulu when it crashed after taking off from Louisville on November 4, 2025. Tragically, 15 people lost their lives in the mishap. The left engine separated during the takeoff roll, and the FAA ordered UPS, FedEx, and Western Global to ground their MD-11s on November 8 until inspections and potential fleetwide follow-on repairs.

The NTSB's preliminary report found fatigue cracks in the left engine mount, crucially including a spherical bearing. According to Aviation Safety News, the failed bearing matched a part Boeing had flagged in a 2011 service letter after failures occurred on three separate aircraft. The NTSB said it is still examining how those inspections were handled, so final conclusions on the cause have not been published.

FreightWaves reported that the company would not bring the jets back even if regulators cleared them. UPS, meanwhile, reported roughly $50 million in extra lease costs to cover the gap in the fourth quarter due to the capacity loss of its downed jets, according to Supply Chain Dive. UPS made its announcement on January 27; the type's retirement was official.

The Federal Aviation Administration and the National Transportation Safety Board fully examined the wreckage of flight 2976 and the data from its flight recorders in the aftermath of the terrible accident. After exhaustive analysis, the FAA and NTSB determined interim mechanical corrective actions to be taken by MD-11 operators to avoid the same catastrophic failures. Unfortunately for the UPS jets, this solution came too late.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
一月份，UPS 航空公司宣布将退役其由 27 架麦道 MD-11 宽体货机组成的整个机队，并由更新的波音 767-300F 取代。这一决定是在 2025 年 11 月路易斯维尔穆罕默德·阿里国际机场 (SDF) 发生坠机事件后做出的，该事件夺去了机组人员以及地面旁观者的生命。飞行安全无疑是首要考虑因素，但有关老化三喷气机的最终决定是基于业务。
对 UPS 2976 航班的调查显示，左翼发动机吊架发生严重故障，需要对机队中的其余飞机进行广泛的无损测试，这导致 UPS 在此期间失去了两打以上的飞机。与联邦快递已将其样本重新投入使用不同，UPS 注销了整个 MD-11 机队，损失近 1.4 亿美元。由于数月的停机时间，重新引进 MD-11 可能会损失几乎同样多的钱。
无论如何，还存在发现更多故障和报废机身的额外风险。然而，与老式三引擎飞机相比，更现代的 767 总重量要轻得多，有效载荷总体积也要小得多。然而，在当前 COVID-19 后电子商务繁荣的航空货运市场中，767 卓越的燃油效率克服了这两个缺点。用 30% 的有效载荷换取 35% 的燃油效率，将使紧急车队重组成为对未来的多种投资。
虽然重型 MD-11 三喷气发动机是为大量洲际有效载荷而制造的，但 767 凭借其节油设计功能，使其在大容量、低密度货物方面表现出色。 767 主导当今航空货运市场的核心原因在于货物密度。在当今以电商为主导的时代，几乎所有装在机身中的包裹尽管体积很大，但都非常轻巧。
MD-11F 的体积比 767-300F 多大约 25%，但它需要三个发动机，并且在飞行的每个阶段都需要显着更高的燃油消耗，才能从 A 点飞往 B 点。767 货运飞机的燃油消耗比旧型三引擎飞机低 35%。仅这一数字就足以使其成为后 COVID-19 市场中快递航空运输的“冠军”。
得益于更现代的技术，767 还拥有近乎完美的机械可靠性和简化的维护计划，确保飞机在机库停留的时间更少，而在空中的时间更长。电子商务需要近乎完美的调度可靠性来满足交付保证。
此外，较小的双发喷气式飞机更安静，并且在任何特定机场都需要更小的占地面积。这使得 UPS、联邦快递和亚马逊 Prime Air 等运营商能够将 767 飞往更靠近最终消费者的小型机场，绕过拥挤的国际大型枢纽。
快递货运的行为与散货不同。包裹在达到飞机的重量限制之前往往会填满机舱空间，因此货机的集装箱位置通常决定其承载量，而不是其额定重量。这就是两架喷气式飞机之间显着相似之处之一，再次严重削弱了 MD-11 的有效载荷优势。两架货机的主甲板面积几乎相等。
尽管 MD-11 是一架更大的飞机，但它只比 767 多携带两个托盘，总共 26 个托盘，而双发喷气式飞机最多可携带 24 个托盘。对于快递物流运营商来说，仅损失两个托盘位置就意味着最小的体积损失。 767 卓越的效率完全掩盖了占地面积的微小减少。
3 台高旁通涡轮风扇发动机（GE CF6-80C2 或 PW4000）
2 台高旁通涡轮风扇发动机（GE CF6-80C2 或 PW4000）
电子商务包装主要由轻质商品、保护性泡沫包装和超大纸板箱组成。由于这种类型的货运缺乏密度，因此在货物重量接近喷气式飞机的极限之前，飞机就完全填满了其物理机舱空间，即所谓的“立方体”。在 MD-11F 上装载轻型电子商务包裹意味着要携带空的、未利用的承重能力，同时还要为第三台发动机支付巨额燃油和维护费用。
2025 年全球航运量普遍降温和货运网络规模缩小，进一步支持了精简飞机足迹的经济理由。在疫情后的多年繁荣之后，全球电子商务需求开始收缩，迫使大型航空公司重新调整其物流足迹。 UPS 实施了全面的网络重组，有意在今年将亚马逊每日包裹量减少 50% 以上。
UPS 2976 号航班是一架飞往檀香山的 MD-11 货机，于 2025 年 11 月 4 日从路易斯维尔起飞后坠毁。不幸的是，15 人在这场事故中丧生。左侧发动机在起飞滑跑过程中分离，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 命令 UPS、联邦快递 (FedEx) 和 Western Global 于 11 月 8 日停飞其 MD-11，直至进行检查和可能的全机队后续维修。
美国国家运输安全委员会的初步报告发现左侧发动机支架存在疲劳裂纹，其中最重要的是一个球面轴承。据《航空安全新闻》报道，发生故障的轴承与波音公司在 2011 年三架不同飞机发生故障后在服务信中标记的零件相符。美国国家运输安全委员会表示，仍在调查这些检查的处理方式，因此尚未公布有关原因的最终结论。
FreightWaves 报道称，即使监管机构批准，该公司也不会恢复这些飞机。与此同时，据 Supply Chain Dive 报道，UPS 报告称，第四季度因飞机坠毁造成运力损失，因此增加了约 5000 万美元的额外租赁成本。 UPS于1月27日发布公告；该类型正式退役。
这场可怕的事故发生后，美国联邦航空管理局和国家运输安全委员会全面检查了 2976 号航班的残骸及其飞行记录器中的数据。经过详尽的分析后，FAA 和 NTSB 确定 MD-11 操作员应采取临时机械纠正措施，以避免同样的灾难性故障。不幸的是，对于 UPS 喷气式飞机来说，这个解决方案来得太晚了。

title_en: The Airbus A350-900ULR's Range Hits 9,700 Nautical Miles Because Parts Were Removed, Not Extra Fuel Tanks
title_zh: 空客 A350-900ULR 的航程达到 9,700 海里，因为部件被拆除，而不是额外的油箱
summary: Typically, more range means more fuel is needed. For the A350-900ULR, the exceptional range it reaches is thanks to far more than just added fuel.
summary_zh: 通常，更大的航程意味着需要更多的燃料。对于 A350-900ULR 而言，其卓越的航程不仅仅归功于添加燃油。
body_en: Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

The operational economics of ultra-long-haul commercial aviation have historically been plagued by severe financial risks and engineering bottlenecks. Deploying widebody aircraft on non-stop routes spanning vast oceanic distances meant that an often unprofitable balance between fuel capacity and passenger payload had to be made. This guide examines the fascinating structural and mechanical evolution of the Airbus A350-900ULR , an aircraft engineered to push the absolute boundaries of modern commercial flight.

Instead of relying on traditional bolt-on auxiliary fuel tanks, Airbus achieved this engineering milestone through a calculated process of structural subtraction and volumetric optimization, by quietly deactivating entire cargo sections and eliminating dense passenger cabins. Contrary to how many of the world's leading airliners are made, the airframe trades mass-market volume for extreme range efficiency.

The quest to connect distant global financial hubs non-stop reached a major turning point during the early part of the twenty-first century. Singapore Airlines pioneered the ambitious longest non-stop link in the world between Singapore Changi Airport (SIN) and Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), designating it as flight SQ21. However, the initial iteration of this ultra-long-haul service relied on the Airbus A340-500 , a heavy, four-engine widebody designed specifically to carry immense fuel loads over long distances.

Although that four-engine aircraft successfully overcame the physical distance, its underlying economic model collapsed when global oil prices experienced dramatic spikes . Operating four separate powerplants created an unsustainable fuel burn profile, rendering the high-profile route financially unviable and forcing its temporary suspension. The failure of the quad-jet highlighted a critical need for a highly efficient, twin-engine platform capable of matching that extreme range without draining corporate cash reserves.
Pick an aircraft to see how many are in the air right now
A380 747 787 A350 777 737 MAX A320neo More types

The development of the Airbus A350-900ULR directly addressed this industry challenge, showing the world that twin-engine operations could totally alter ultra-long-haul economics in favor of the new twin-engined era. Equipped with advanced Rolls-Royce Trent XWB engines, the clean-sheet design offered a massive leap forward in aerodynamic efficiency and fuel burn reduction. Achieving a maximum operational range of 9,700 nautical miles (11,163 miles / 17,964 km), the twin-engine variant allowed network planners to sustainably reopen the world's longest commercial air bridges.

A pervasive misconception is that an aircraft can only achieve ultra-long-range performance by installing heavy, bolt-on auxiliary fuel tanks inside the lower cargo decks. Historically, older models followed this exact design philosophy, sacrificing structural efficiency to carry extra fuel weight. However, the engineering team behind the modified twin-engine jet completely rejected this traditional layout strategy.

Instead of adding heavy physical structures to the A350-900ULR, engineers gained an additional 24,000 liters (6,340 US gallons) of fuel capacity by cleverly modifying the internal architecture of the existing wing and center wing box. Technicians achieved this by repurposing the existing internal vent space and strategically relocating complex fuel sensors. This brilliant optimization pushed the total usable fuel capacity from the baseline standard of roughly 141,000 liters (37,248 US gallons) up to a massive 165,000 liters (43,588 US gallons) without changing the exterior skin of the wing tanks.

The volumetric optimization shown here is a masterclass in modern aerospace design, as it avoids the inherent weight penalties of auxiliary tank frames. Utilizing existing, under-allocated internal spaces, the aircraft maintains its clean aerodynamic lines and structural integrity. It allows the wings to flex and efficiently support the increased fuel weight during the initial stages of long-haul flight.

Lifting off with a fully loaded fuel system containing 165,000 liters (43,588 US gallons) of combustible jet fuel introduces immense physical stress to any airframe. To accommodate this massive liquid weight, the aircraft's certified maximum takeoff weight was raised significantly. Engineers officially pushed the maximum takeoff weight parameter to a substantial 280 tonnes (617,294 lbs) to ensure structural safety during departure.

However, increasing the maximum takeoff weight parameter alone is insufficient to offset the intense physical forces concentrated across the forward fuselage sections. To successfully balance the overall weight distribution, Singapore Airlines has to completely deactivate the forward cargo hold on these specialized airframes. Such a drastic operational measure requires giving up exactly 19 tonnes (41,888 lbs) of high-yield commercial belly freight payload capacity.

Forgoing commercial cargo space is a massive operational trade-off that completely flips the traditional revenue model of widebody operations. On standard international flights, cargo carried beneath the passenger deck provides a highly reliable financial baseline that subsidizes fluctuating ticket yields. Stripping out this capability means that network planners must rely entirely on the passenger cabin to turn a profit on every single frequency.

The second critical step in managing the aircraft's strict weight limits takes place directly within the passenger cabin architecture. A standard baseline variant of this twin-engine jet typically accommodates well over 300 travelers arranged across a traditional three-class layout. To enable a non-stop journey across 9,700 nautical miles (11,163 miles / 17,964 km), the internal density required an aggressive structural reduction.

Singapore Airlines resolved this challenge by configuring its specialized subfleet with a low-density layout containing only 161 total seats. The layout is notable for completely eliminating the traditional economy class cabin from the aircraft entirely. Instead, the ultra-long-range interior features a premium-heavy configuration split cleanly between 67 spacious business class seats and 94 dedicated premium economy slots.

Removing standard economy rows eliminates a massive amount of physical dead weight before the aircraft even fuels up. This subtraction goes far beyond the physical weight of the seats themselves, wiping out the mass of more than 150 additional passengers, their heavy checked baggage, and their carry-on items. Furthermore, the reduction allows the airline to trim down galley equipment, heavy food carts, and thousands of pounds of potable water, creating the necessary weight margin to carry maximum fuel.
body_zh: 航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。
超远程商业航空的运营经济历来受到严重的财务风险和工程瓶颈的困扰。在跨越广阔海洋的直达航线上部署宽体飞机意味着必须在燃油容量和乘客有效载荷之间取得通常无利可图的平衡。本指南探讨了空中客车 A350-900ULR 令人着迷的结构和机械演变，这是一款旨在突破现代商业飞行绝对界限的飞机。
空中客车公司没有依赖传统的螺栓固定式辅助油箱，而是通过结构减减和体积优化的计算过程，悄悄停用整个货舱部分并消除密集的客舱，实现了这一工程里程碑。与世界上许多领先客机的制造量相反，该机身以大众市场销量换取了极高的航程效率。
二十世纪初期，不间断地连接遥远的全球金融中心的追求达到了一个重大转折点。新加坡航空开创了新加坡樟宜机场 (SIN) 和纽瓦克自由国际机场 (EWR) 之间世界上最长的直飞航线，并将其指定为 SQ21 航班。然而，这种超长途服务的最初迭代依赖于空中客车 A340-500，这是一款重型四引擎宽体飞机，专门设计用于长距离运输巨大的燃油负载。
尽管这架四引擎飞机成功地克服了物理距离，但当全球油价急剧飙升时，其基础经济模式崩溃了。运营四个独立的发电厂造成了不可持续的燃油燃烧状况，使得这条备受瞩目的航线在财务上不可行，并迫使其暂时停运。四引擎飞机的失败凸显了对高效双引擎平台的迫切需求，该平台能够在不耗尽公司现金储备的情况下满足极端航程。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
空中客车 A350-900ULR 的开发直接解决了这一行业挑战，向世界展示了双引擎运营可以完全改变超远程经济性，有利于新的双引擎时代。全新的设计配备了先进的劳斯莱斯遄达 XWB 发动机，在空气动力学效率和燃油消耗减少方面实现了巨大飞跃。双引擎型号的最大航程达到 9,700 海里（11,163 英里/17,964 公里），使网络规划者能够可持续地重新开放世界上最长的商业空中桥梁。
一个普遍的误解是，飞机只有在下货舱内安装重型螺栓固定式辅助油箱才能实现超远程性能。从历史上看，旧型号遵循了这种精确的设计理念，牺牲结构效率来承载额外的燃油重量。然而，改装双引擎喷气式飞机背后的工程团队完全拒绝了这种传统的布局策略。

工程师没有为 A350-900ULR 添加重型物理结构，而是通过巧妙修改现有机翼和中央翼盒的内部结构，获得了额外 24,000 升（6,340 美制加仑）的燃油容量。技术人员通过重新利用现有的内部通风空间并战略性地重新安置复杂的燃油传感器来实现这一目标。这一出色的优化将总可用燃油容量从大约 141,000 升（37,248 美制加仑）的基准标准提高到了 165,000 升（43,588 美制加仑），并且没有改变机翼油箱的外部蒙皮。
这里展示的体积优化是现代航空航天设计的大师级作品，因为它避免了辅助油箱框架固有的重量损失。利用现有的、分配不足的内部空间，飞机保持了干净的空气动力学线条和结构完整性。它允许机翼弯曲并在长途飞行的初始阶段有效支撑增加的燃油重量。
使用包含 165,000 升（43,588 美制加仑）可燃喷气燃料的满载燃料系统升空会给任何机身带来巨大的物理压力。为了适应如此巨大的液体重量，飞机的认证最大起飞重量显着提高。工程师正式将最大起飞重量参数推至 280 吨（617,294 磅），以确保起飞期间的结构安全。
然而，仅增加最大起飞重量参数不足以抵消集中在机身前部的强烈物理力。为了成功平衡整体重量分布，新加坡航空必须完全停用这些专用机身上的前货舱。如此严厉的运营措施需要放弃 19 吨（41,888 磅）的高收益商业腹舱货运有效载荷。
放弃商业货运空间是一项巨大的运营权衡，彻底颠覆了宽体机运营的传统收入模式。在标准国际航班上，乘客甲板下运输的货物提供了高度可靠的财务基准，可以补贴波动的机票收益。剥离这种能力意味着网络规划者必须完全依靠客舱来在每个频率上盈利。
管理飞机严格重量限制的第二个关键步骤直接在客舱结构内进行。这种双引擎喷气式飞机的标准基线型号通常可容纳超过 300 名旅客，采用传统的三舱布局。为了实现 9,700 海里（11,163 英里/17,964 公里）的不间断航行，需要积极减少结构内部密度。
新加坡航空通过将其专业子机队配置为低密度布局，仅包含 161 个座位，解决了这一挑战。该布局的显着之处在于完全消除了飞机上的传统经济舱。相反，超远程内饰采用高端重型配置，干净地划分为 67 个宽敞的商务舱座椅和 94 个专用高端经济舱座位。
取消标准经济舱排可以在飞机加油之前消除大量的物理自重。这种减重远远超出了座椅本身的实际重量，还消除了 150 多名额外乘客、沉重的托运行李和随身携带物品的重量。此外，这种减少使航空公司能够减少厨房设备、重型餐车和数千磅的饮用水，从而创造必要的重量裕度来携带最大的燃料。

title_en: United Airlines Flies Far More Boeing Narrowbodies, But Says The Airbus A321neo Is Its Passengers' Favorite
title_zh: 联合航空运营更多波音窄体飞机，但表示空客 A321neo 是乘客的最爱
summary: United operates far more Boeing narrowbodies, yet its Airbus A321neo leads customer satisfaction thanks to smarter cabin features and connectivity
summary_zh: 美联航运营的波音窄体飞机数量远超预期，但其空客 A321neo 凭借更智能的机舱功能和连接性引领客户满意度
body_en: United Airlines Flies Far More Boeing Narrowbodies, But Says The Airbus A321neo Is Its Passengers' Favorite

Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

United Airlines has built much of its domestic operation around Boeing narrowbodies, operating hundreds of 737s alongside its long-serving 757 fleet. But the aircraft the airline says earns its highest customer satisfaction scores is an Airbus : the A321neo, a relatively new addition to United's fleet that is winning over passengers’ hearts despite a cabin configuration that prioritizes capacity.

The contrast raises an interesting question about United's fleet strategy. If Boeing aircraft remain the backbone of its narrowbody operation, why has the airline singled out the A321neo as its best-performing aircraft for customer satisfaction, and what does that reveal about the features travelers value most? The answer involves more than seat pitch; onboard entertainment, connectivity, thoughtful cabin amenities, and Boeing's delivery challenges all play a part.
Why United's Airbus A321neo Is Winning Over Passengers

United's endorsement of the A321neo is unusually direct. According to our previous report on United's best domestic aircraft , Toby Enqvist, United's chief global operations officer, described the aircraft as the airline's highest-scoring aircraft for customer service satisfaction. The assessment is particularly notable because United operates far more Boeing narrowbodies than Airbus aircraft, so the A321neo has a much smaller presence across the airline's network.

The A321neo's success also challenges the assumption that passenger satisfaction depends primarily on cabin space. United configures the aircraft with 200 seats, including 20 in first class, 57 in Economy Plus, and 123 in standard economy. That is a relatively dense layout compared with Delta Air Lines ' 194-seat configuration and American Airlines ' 196-seat arrangement, as discussed in our coverage of United's A321neo . Although these layouts differ in their precise cabin allocations, the comparison shows that United's highly rated aircraft isn't a low-density premium product.

Instead, the A321neo seems to benefit from the cumulative effect of small features that enhance the journey. Large seatback entertainment screens, an extensive content library, onboard WiFi, and a self-service snack area all contribute to the experience. These features can make a flight feel more comfortable and convenient without requiring the airline to sacrifice many seats.

For an airline with a vast domestic network, aircraft must appeal to passengers while remaining economically viable to operate. If United can improve customer satisfaction without giving up a relatively high seat count, the A321neo could be a strong fit. To see why, it helps to look at the aircraft that still make up most of United's fleet.
United's Boeing Narrowbody Fleet Remains Much Larger

United Airlines' Airbus A321neo may be its highest-rated aircraft for customer satisfaction, but Boeing still dominates the carrier's narrowbody fleet. According to Planespotters.net's United Airlines fleet database , the airline's fleet includes 40 Boeing 737 -700s, 141 737-800s, 136 737-900ERs, 123 737 MAX 8s, and 182 737 MAX 9s. United also operates 12 Boeing 737-900s and 61 Boeing 757 s, demonstrating how extensively the manufacturer is represented across the airline's domestic and transcontinental operations.

Airbus nevertheless has an established presence at United, with 69 A319-100s and 64 A320-200s in the fleet, alongside 77 A321neos. The A321neo is the newest of these three Airbus narrowbody types and offers additional passenger capacity for routes where demand justifies a larger single-aisle aircraft. As Aerospace Global News reported in its 2026 fleet review , United is pursuing a broad fleet modernization and expansion strategy. The A321neo's growing role is part of that process, although Boeing's 737 family remains the backbone of its narrowbody operation.

The figures put the scale of the difference into perspective. United has 634 Boeing 737s listed, compared with 77 Airbus A321neos, meaning the A321neo remains a relatively small part of its overall narrowbody operation. The airline's favorable customer satisfaction assessment is particularly interesting: an aircraft operating in far smaller numbers has earned stronger passenger feedback than the Boeing types that carry much of United's domestic traffic. The A321neo stands out not simply for its size, but for how United has equipped its cabin and designed the onboard experience.
Big Screens, WiFi & Snacks: The Details Behind The Scores

The explanation may lie in the details passengers encounter throughout a flight. In its April 2026 analysis, Cranky Flier argued that United's onboard experience demonstrates how seemingly modest amenities can collectively influence customer satisfaction. Instead of relying on one standout luxury feature, the airline can improve the overall journey through entertainment, connectivity, and easy access to refreshments.

Seatback screens are a particularly visible part of that proposition. Passengers can access entertainment without relying solely on their own phones or tablets, and a substantial content library gives them more options during a flight. On longer domestic sectors, where travelers may spend several hours in the same seat, that convenience can make a meaningful difference to the perceived quality of the journey.

Connectivity is another important factor. United is rolling out Starlink satellite internet across its fleet, and in its second-quarter 2026 results , the airline reported that it had installed Starlink on 450 United mainline and United Express aircraft at the time of the announcement. The carrier also reported that customer satisfaction scores on Starlink-equipped flights were twice as high as on other flights. That fleet-wide finding doesn't prove connectivity alone explains the A321neo's ranking, but it reinforces the importance of the onboard digital experience.

The A321neo's and XLR’s self-service snack bar at the rear of the cabin adds another practical touch. Instead of treating refreshments as something available only through a conventional service interaction, the arrangement gives passengers a convenient way to access snacks. Combined with entertainment and improved connectivity, these amenities help explain why passengers might rate the aircraft highly even without the most spacious economy cabin.
body_zh: 联合航空运营更多波音窄体飞机，但表示空客 A321neo 是乘客的最爱
经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
联合航空的大部分国内业务都是围绕波音窄体飞机展开的，除了长期服役的 757 机队之外，还运营着数百架 737 飞机。但该航空公司表示，获得最高客户满意度评分的飞机是空客：A321neo，这是美联航机队中相对较新的成员，尽管客舱配置优先考虑运力，但它赢得了乘客的心。
这种对比引发了一个关于曼联机队战略的有趣问题。如果波音飞机仍然是其窄体机运营的支柱，那么为什么该航空公司选择 A321neo 作为其客户满意度方面表现最好的飞机？这揭示了旅客最看重的功能的哪些特点？答案不仅仅涉及座椅间距；还涉及座椅间距。机上娱乐、连通性、周到的客舱设施以及波音的交付挑战都发挥了作用。
为什么美联航的空客 A321neo 赢得了乘客的青睐
美联航对 A321neo 的认可异常直接。根据我们之前关于美联航最佳国内飞机的报告，美联航首席全球运营官 Toby Enqvist 将该飞机描述为该航空公司客户服务满意度得分最高的飞机。这项评估尤其值得注意，因为美联航运营的波音窄体飞机远多于空客飞机，因此 A321neo 在该航空公司网络中的占比要小得多。

A321neo 的成功也挑战了乘客满意度主要取决于客舱空间的假设。美联航为这架飞机配置了 200 个座位，其中头等舱 20 个、豪华经济舱 57 个、标准经济舱 123 个。与达美航空的 194 座配置和美国航空的 196 座布局相比，这是一个相对密集的布局，正如我们在美联航 A321neo 的报道中所讨论的那样。尽管这些布局在精确的客舱分配方面有所不同，但比较表明美联航的高评价飞机并不是低密度的优质产品。
相反，A321neo 似乎受益于增强旅程的小功能的累积效应。大型座椅靠背娱乐屏幕、丰富的内容库、机上 WiFi 和自助小吃区都有助于提升体验。这些功能可以使飞行感觉更加舒适和方便，而无需航空公司牺牲许多座位。
对于拥有庞大国内网络的航空公司来说，飞机必须吸引乘客，同时保持运营的经济可行性。如果美联航能够在不放弃相对较多座位数的情况下提高客户满意度，那么 A321neo 可能是一个不错的选择。要了解其中的原因，不妨看看仍占美联航机队大部分的飞机。
美联航的波音窄体机机队规模仍然更大

联合航空的空客 A321neo 可能是其客户满意度最高的飞机，但波音仍然在该航空公司的窄体机机队中占据主导地位。根据 Planespotters.net 的联合航空机队数据库，该航空公司的机队包括 40 架波音 737 -700、141 737-800、136 737-900ER、123 737 MAX 8 和 182 737 MAX 9。美联航还运营 12 架波音 737-900 和 61 架波音 757，这表明该制造商在该航空公司的国内和洲际运营中拥有广泛的影响力。

尽管如此，空中客车公司在美联航仍占有一席之地，机队中拥有 69 架 A319-100 和 64 架 A320-200，以及 77 架 A321neo。 A321neo 是这三种空客窄体机机型中最新的一款，可为需求较大的单通道飞机的航线提供额外的载客量。正如《航空航天全球新闻》在 2026 年机队回顾中报道的那样，美联航正在推行广泛的机队现代化和扩张战略。尽管波音 737 系列仍然是其窄体机业务的支柱，但 A321neo 日益增长的作用是这一过程的一部分。
这些数字直观地展示了差异的规模。美联航有 634 架波音 737 飞机，而空客 A321neo 飞机有 77 架，这意味着 A321neo 在其整个窄体机运营中仍然只占相对较小的一部分。该航空公司良好的客户满意度评估尤其有趣：与承载美联航大部分国内航班的波音机型相比，运营数量少得多的飞机赢得了更强烈的乘客反馈。 A321neo 的脱颖而出不仅在于其尺寸，还在于美联航的机舱装备和机上体验设计。
大屏幕、WiFi 和零食：分数背后的细节
解释可能在于乘客在整个飞行过程中遇到的细节。在 2026 年 4 月的分析中，Cranky Flier 认为，美联航的机上体验表明，看似朴素的设施如何共同影响客户满意度。航空公司可以通过娱乐、连通性和轻松获取茶点来改善整体旅程，而不是依赖一项出色的豪华功能。
座椅靠背屏幕是这一主张中特别明显的一部分。乘客无需仅仅依靠自己的手机或平板电脑即可获得娱乐，丰富的内容库为他们在飞行过程中提供了更多选择。在长途国内航班上，旅客可能会在同一个座位上花费几个小时，这种便利性可以对旅程的感知质量产生有意义的影响。
连接性是另一个重要因素。美联航正在其机队中推出 Starlink 卫星互联网，该航空公司在 2026 年第二季度业绩中报告称，截至发布公告时，已在 450 架美联航干线和联航快运飞机上安装了 Starlink。该航空公司还报告称，配备星链的航班的客户满意度得分是其他航班的两倍。这一整个机队的发现并不能证明连接性本身就可以解释 A321neo 的排名，但它强调了机上数字体验的重要性。
A321neo 和 XLR 客舱后部的自助小吃店增添了另一种实用的感觉。这种安排不再将茶点视为只能通过传统服务交互提供的东西，而是为乘客提供了一种获取小吃的便捷方式。结合娱乐和改进的连接性，这些设施有助于解释为什么即使没有最宽敞的经济舱，乘客也会对飞机给予高度评价。

title_en: Alaska Airlines Cancels 7 Nonstop Routes From Major City: See Full List Now
title_zh: 阿拉斯加航空取消 7 条从主要城市出发的直达航线：立即查看完整列表
summary: Seven nonstop LAX routes vanish as capacity shifts to higher demand hubs and more profitable coastal markets.
summary_zh: 随着运力转移到需求更高的枢纽和利润更高的沿海市场，7 条直达洛杉矶国际机场的航线消失了。
body_en: Alaska Airlines Cancels 7 Nonstop Routes From Major City: See Full List Now

Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

Alaska Airlines has shaved seven nonstop routes from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) in the last two years, as the airline continues to adjust its network and maintain its presence as one of the largest airlines on the US West Coast.

While Los Angeles sits as the airline's fifth busiest airport by weekly departures, this is just a quarter of that seen at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA), its biggest hub. Between January 2025 and May 2026, four international and three domestic routes have been suspended from Los Angeles. Data for this article has been sourced from Cirium , an online aviation analytics company.

Domestically, Alaska has shaved three domestic routes from its network at Los Angeles, as the airline redeploys its aircraft on more lucrative routes. The airline suspended its nonstop service to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) in January of last year, a seasonal service which is unlikely to return.

Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) lost its nonstop service by Alaska from Los Angeles in August 2025, as the airline reported a drop in demand on the route. Instead, the airline has retained its Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA) service.

The final domestic link to be suspended was between Los Angeles and Reno Tahoe International Airport (RNO). This came as part of the airline's broader network realignment, and leaves Alaska's three sole services from Reno to Seattle, Portland International Airport (PDX) and San Diego (SAN).
Two Alaska Airlines Destinations In Mexico Terminated From Los Angeles
Weaker demand to Mexico has seen Alaska remove its nonstop flights from Los Angeles to Monterrey (MTY) in October 2025, while Cancun was also removed from the airline's network in May this year.
Found an error? Send it info@simpleflying.com so it can be corrected.

This leaves Alaska operating to just eight Mexican destinations, which include Guadalajara (GDL), Ixtapa/Zihuatanejo (ZIH), La Paz (LAP), Loreto (LTO), Manzanillo (ZLO), Mazatlán (MZT), Puerto Vallarta (PVR), San José del Cabo (SJD).
Alaska maintains around 3.6% of the market share for travel between the US and Mexico, as reported by OAG . This is around 2.13 million passengers each year.
Alaska Airlines Flights To Nassau And Kelowna Are Gone

Alaska cut its nonstop flight from Los Angeles to Nassau (NAS) in August 2025. The carrier cut the route to the Bahamas due to poor performance. Alaska had previously also operated nonstop flights to Nassau from Seattle, but this route was also cut last year. The airline no longer serves Nassau, meaning there are currently no flights to the US West Coast from the Bahamas. This leaves Denver International Airport (DEN) and Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) as the closest transit points with other carriers.
There is no other airline operating this route

Kelowna (YLW), in Canada, was a seasonal service offered by Alaska Airlines, providing nonstop flights to this picturesque region of British Columbia. The route was axed in March of this year, leaving no carrier serving the city pair. Alaska now provides one-stop service to Kelowna through its year-round flights from Seattle.

Los Angeles is Alaska Airlines' fifth-largest airport by number of weekly departures, with 533 scheduled on average each week. The airline's largest airports, in order of weekly departures, are Seattle, Portland (PDX), Honolulu (HNL), San Diego (SAN), and Los Angeles.
body_zh: 阿拉斯加航空取消 7 条从主要城市出发的直达航线：立即查看完整列表
记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
阿拉斯加航空在过去两年中削减了 7 条从洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 出发的直飞航线，该公司不断调整其网络并保持其作为美国西海岸最大航空公司之一的地位。
虽然洛杉矶是该航空公司每周出发航班第五繁忙的机场，但这只是其最大枢纽西雅图塔科马国际机场 (SEA) 的四分之一。 2025年1月至2026年5月期间，从洛杉矶出发的4条国际航线和3条国内航线已暂停。本文的数据来自在线航空分析公司 Cirium。
在国内方面，阿拉斯加航空公司已将其在洛杉矶的航线网络中的三条国内航线削减，因为该航空公司将其飞机重新部署到利润更丰厚的航线上。该航空公司于去年 1 月暂停了飞往劳德代尔堡好莱坞国际机场 (FLL) 的直达航班，这项季节性航班不太可能恢复。
华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场 (IAD) 于 2025 年 8 月失去了从洛杉矶出发的阿拉斯加直飞航班，因为该航空公司报告该航线的需求下降。相反，该航空公司保留了罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场 (DCA) 的服务。
最后暂停的国内航班是洛杉矶和里诺太浩国际机场 (RNO) 之间的航班。这是该航空公司更广泛的网络重组的一部分，阿拉斯加航空仅保留从里诺飞往西雅图、波特兰国际机场 (PDX) 和圣地亚哥 (SAN) 的三项航班。
阿拉斯加航空终止从洛杉矶飞往墨西哥的两个目的地
由于对墨西哥的需求疲软，阿拉斯加航空于 2025 年 10 月取消了从洛杉矶飞往蒙特雷 (MTY) 的直飞航班，而坎昆也于今年 5 月从该航空公司的网络中删除。
发现错误？将其发送至 info@simpleflying.com 以便进行更正。
这使得阿拉斯加仅飞往八个墨西哥目的地，其中包括瓜达拉哈拉 (GDL)、伊斯塔帕/锡瓦塔塔内霍 (ZIH)、拉巴斯 (LAP)、洛雷托 (LTO)、曼萨尼约 (ZLO)、马萨特兰 (MZT)、巴亚尔塔港 (PVR) 和圣何塞德尔卡波 (SJD)。
据 OAG 报道，阿拉斯加在美国和墨西哥之间的旅行市场份额中保持着 3.6% 左右。这相当于每年约 213 万名旅客。
阿拉斯加航空飞往拿骚和基洛纳的航班取消
阿拉斯加航空于 2025 年 8 月削减了从洛杉矶飞往拿骚 (NAS) 的直飞航班。由于表现不佳，该航空公司削减了飞往巴哈马的航线。阿拉斯加此前也运营过从西雅图飞往拿骚的直飞航班，但这条航线去年也被削减。该航空公司不再提供拿骚航班，这意味着目前没有从巴哈马飞往美国西海岸的航班。这使得丹佛国际机场 (DEN) 和达拉斯/沃斯堡国际机场 (DFW) 成为距离其他航空公司最近的中转站。
目前没有其他航空公司运营该航线
加拿大基洛纳 (YLW) 是阿拉斯加航空提供的季节性航班，提供飞往不列颠哥伦比亚省这个风景如画的地区的直达航班。该航线于今年三月被取消，没有任何航空公司为这两个城市提供服务。阿拉斯加现在通过从西雅图出发的全年航班提供飞往基洛纳的一站式服务。
按每周出发航班数量计算，洛杉矶是阿拉斯加航空第五大机场，平均每周有 533 班航班。该航空公司最大的机场（按每周出发次数排列）为西雅图、波特兰 (PDX)、檀香山 (HNL)、圣地亚哥 (SAN) 和洛杉矶。

title_en: How Pilots Rest & Sleep On The Boeing 777-300ER
title_zh: 飞行员如何在波音 777-300ER 上休息和睡眠
summary: For flights heading into double-digit flight hours, pilots need a chance to rest to stay alert. On the 777-300ER, getting rest is no problem at all
summary_zh: 对于即将进入两位数飞行时间的航班，飞行员需要有机会休息以保持警惕。在 777-300ER 上，休息完全不是问题
body_en: Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

Did you know that the two aviators sitting at the primary controls of a Boeing 777-300ER may not be the same crew members who performed the takeoff hours earlier? Suspended directly above paying passengers in the forward cabin ceiling, off-duty pilots sleep in complete darkness inside an isolated loft module. This hidden space lets commercial airlines stretch twin-engine range across vast oceanic voids, but managing human fatigue at six miles (9.7 kilometers) above the earth is far more complicated than pulling down a window shade.

Resolving the limit of pilot endurance led Boeing engineers and Federal Aviation Administration regulators to reconsider how narrow structural spaces inside a pressurized widebody airframe are actually used. Designing a secure, fully isolated sleeping facility meant creating a functional space within the airframe crown without sacrificing profitable main-deck cabin space or compromising flight deck communications. How this overhead suite balances strict regulatory sleep requirements against the harsh acoustic environment of two massive GE90 engines is easily one of the most clever spatial engineering achievements in modern long-haul transport.

On long-haul 777-300ER routes, off-duty flight deck crews rest in an Overhead Flight Crew Rest module located in the upper fuselage crown directly above the forward passenger cabin. Access to this elevated sanctuary is intentionally discreet, situated behind an armored security door near the forward galley that requires a keypad code to unlock. Behind this entrance lies a steep, ladder-like staircase leading upward into the ceiling structure, completely isolating resting aviators from the passenger aisle below. However, stepping beyond that security door reveals a design compromise between spatial efficiency and regulatory mandates.

According to Boeing technical documentation for the 777 series, the forward overhead installation occupies the unused crown area between Door 1 and the forward passenger cabin frame. Instead of converting valuable main-deck floor space that could otherwise house four to six revenue-generating business class suites, engineers moved the module into the upper contour of the fuselage. The exact internal layout varies depending on individual airline specifications, with carriers choosing between two reclining business class seats paired with two lie-flat bunks, or specialized configurations incorporating additional storage and workstation amenities. Maintaining structural integrity and sound dampening within a module measuring less than six feet (1.8 meters) in height is by no means easy, so the aircraft is fitted with insulation materials to isolate resting pilots from ambient cabin noise.

Carving out an overhead attic space solves the immediate problem of finding physical room for off-duty flight crews without sacrificing ticket revenue. However, simply providing a secluded loft inside the ceiling of a twinjet does not automatically make it a legally compliant sleeping environment for transoceanic operations.

To legally qualify as a Class 1 Rest Facility under Federal Aviation Administration guidelines , an onboard rest compartment must provide a fully enclosed sleeping environment featuring independent climate controls, adjustable lighting, and lie-flat bunks that allow horizontal sleep. Bunks must be structurally isolated from both flight deck and passenger cabin noise, maintaining ambient sound levels low enough to enable restorative sleep. FAA regulations require the area to allow an aviator to lie completely flat on a mattress at least 78 inches (198 centimeters) long and 30 inches (76 centimeters) wide, surrounded by sound-dampening curtains and fire-resistant materials.

Structural isolation alone is insufficient; the compartment must be equipped with dedicated environmental systems and emergency hardware equal to the main flight deck. Similarly to how cabin crew can control cabin temperature , Boeing builds independent temperature controls into the 777-300ER overhead rest module, allowing off-duty aviators to adjust airflow without altering passenger cabin settings. Each bunk contains individual emergency oxygen masks connected to an independent oxygen supply within the compartment, alongside full-body seatbelt harnesses designed to keep sleeping pilots secured during severe clear-air turbulence. Furthermore, dedicated interphone handsets and smoke detection systems link the overhead suite to the active flight deck and cabin crew stations, providing immediate communication if an operational emergency arises.

Operating a fully certified Class 1 facility satisfies regulatory safety thresholds, but an exceptional resting space gives little benefit if a flight crew cannot structure their sleep effectively. On ultra-long-haul sectors pushing 15 hours or more, balancing circadian rhythms against operational flight phases becomes a complex physiological equation. Therefore, airlines need to be able to manage strict shift rotations across multiple crew members to guarantee that two fully alert aviators are always at the controls during critical flight phases.

When long-haul sectors exceed ten to 12 hours, standard two-pilot flight deck complements are replaced by augmented crews to meet strict fatigue risk management standards. Depending on total flight length and specific operator regulations, routes spanning 12 to 14 hours use a three-pilot crew consisting of one captain and two first officers , or two captains and one first officer, as noted in Simple Flying coverage. For ultra-long-haul sectors exceeding 14 hours, airlines will use a four-pilot heavy crew, effectively creating two complete flight teams that rotate between active flight deck duty and protected rest periods in the overhead suite.

On a 15-hour transoceanic flight, flight dispatchers structure the cruise phase into multi-hour rest blocks designed to align with natural human sleep cycles. To maintain an undisturbed environment inside the overhead module, strict cabin protocols prohibit audible phone alarms, requiring resting aviators to rely on silent vibrating wrist devices or quiet interphone calls from active flight deck personnel. Scheduling shifts so each pilot gets at least one full 90-minute sleep cycle helps preserve cognitive acuity and reaction times when navigating complex arrivals across multiple time zones, as The Stork Life notes .

Regulating rest periods across long oceanic sectors is what keeps flight deck personnel alert throughout the journey. That is the nature of an airline flight deck: pilots need to perform at their best during their assigned period of command. What can often be a challenge is transitioning an aviator from deep slumber in a dark overhead bunk back to active control of a complex widebody jet. When a pilot finally wakes up and heads to the cockpit, this can be a point of risk.
body_zh: 航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。
您是否知道坐在波音 777-300ER 飞机主控制台上的两名飞行员可能不是几小时前执行起飞的同一名机组人员？下班的飞行员悬挂在付费乘客正上方的前舱天花板上，在完全黑暗的隔离阁楼模块内睡觉。这个隐藏的空间让商业航空公司可以将双引擎的航程扩展到广阔的海洋空间，但在距地球六英里（9.7公里）的地方管理人类疲劳比拉下窗帘要复杂得多。
解决飞行员耐力的限制促使波音工程师和美国联邦航空管理局监管机构重新考虑加压宽体机身内部狭窄结构空间的实际使用情况。设计一个安全、完全隔离的睡眠设施意味着在机身顶部创建一个功能空间，而不会牺牲有利可图的主甲板客舱空间或损害驾驶舱通信。这套头顶套件如何在严格的监管睡眠要求与两台大型 GE90 发动机的恶劣声学环境之间取得平衡，无疑是现代长途运输中最聪明的空间工程成就之一。
在长途 777-300ER 航线上，下班的驾驶舱机组人员会在位于前客舱正上方机身上部顶部的头顶飞行机组休息模块中休息。进入这个高架避难所的通道是故意谨慎的，位于前厨房附近的装甲安全门后面，需要键盘密码才能解锁。在这个入口后面有一个陡峭的梯子状楼梯，向上通向天花板结构，将休息的飞行员与下面的乘客通道完全隔离。然而，跨过安全门揭示了空间效率和监管要求之间的设计折衷。

根据波音 777 系列技术文件，前部头顶安装占据 1 号门和前部客舱框架之间未使用的顶部区域。工程师们没有将宝贵的主甲板空间（本来可以容纳四到六间创收的商务舱套房）改建，而是将模块移至机身的上轮廓。确切的内部布局根据各个航空公司的规格而有所不同，航空公司可以选择两个可倾斜的商务舱座椅搭配两个平躺式铺位，或者包含额外存储和工作站设施的特殊配置。在高度不到 6 英尺（1.8 米）的模块内保持结构完整性和隔音绝非易事，因此飞机配备了隔热材料，以将休息的飞行员与机舱周围的噪音隔离。
开辟一个头顶阁楼空间解决了为下班的机组人员寻找物理空间的紧迫问题，同时又不牺牲机票收入。然而，仅仅在双喷气机的天花板内提供一个僻静的阁楼并不能自动使其成为跨洋操作的合法睡眠环境。
要根据联邦航空管理局的指导方针合法地获得 1 级休息设施的资格，机上休息舱必须提供完全封闭的睡眠环境，具有独立的气候控制、可调节的照明以及允许水平睡眠的平躺式床铺。铺位必须在结构上与驾驶舱和客舱噪音隔离，保持环境噪音水平足够低，以实现恢复性睡眠。 FAA 规定要求该区域允许飞行员完全平躺在至少 78 英寸（198 厘米）长、30 英寸（76 厘米）宽的床垫上，周围铺有隔音窗帘和防火材料。

仅有结构隔离是不够的；舱内必须配备与主驾驶舱同等的专用环境系统和应急硬件。与机组人员控制机舱温度的方式类似，波音公司在 777-300ER 头顶休息模块中内置了独立的温度控制装置，允许下班的飞行员在不改变客舱设置的情况下调节气流。每个铺位均配有独立的紧急氧气面罩，与舱内独立的氧气供应系统相连，还有全身安全带，旨在确保飞行员在严重的晴空湍流中保持睡眠。此外，专用对讲电话和烟雾探测系统将头顶套件与活动驾驶舱和机组人员站连接起来，在出现运行紧急情况时提供即时通信。
运营经过全面认证的 1 级设施可以满足监管安全阈值，但如果机组人员不能有效地安排睡眠，那么特殊的休息空间就没有什么好处。在飞行时间长达 15 小时或更长时间的超长途航段中，平衡昼夜节律与飞行运行阶段成为一个复杂的生理方程。因此，航空公司需要能够管理多名机组人员的严格轮班，以确保在关键飞行阶段始终有两名高度警觉的飞行员处于控制之中。

当长途航段超过 10 至 12 小时时，标准的两名飞行员驾驶舱人员将被增援的机组人员取代，以满足严格的疲劳风险管理标准。根据总飞行长度和具体运营商规定，跨越 12 至 14 小时的航线使用三名飞行员，其中包括一名机长和两名副驾驶，或两名机长和一名副驾驶，如 Simple Flying 报道中所述。对于超过 14 小时的超远程航段，航空公司将使用四名飞行员的重型机组人员，从而有效地创建两个完整的飞行团队，在驾驶舱的活跃值班和头顶套间的受保护休息时间​​之间轮换。

在 15 小时的跨洋飞行中，飞行调度员将巡航阶段分为多个小时的休息时段，旨在与人类的自然睡眠周期保持一致。为了保持头顶模块内不受干扰的环境，严格的客舱协议禁止声音电话警报，要求休息的飞行员依靠无声振动手腕设备或来自活跃驾驶舱人员的安静对讲电话。正如 The Stork Life 指出的那样，安排轮班时间，让每位飞行员至少获得一个完整的 90 分钟睡眠周期，有助于在跨越多个时区的复杂抵达航班时保持认知敏锐度和反应时间。
规范长途航段的休息时间可以让驾驶舱人员在整个旅程中保持警惕。这就是航空公司驾驶舱的本质：飞行员需要在指定的指挥期间发挥最佳水平。通常面临的挑战是将飞行员从黑暗的头顶铺位中的沉睡状态转变为对复杂的宽体喷气式飞机的主动控制。当飞行员最终醒来并前往驾驶舱时，这可能是一个风险点。

title_en: Ryanair passengers spend eight hours flying to England and back to Spain
title_zh: 瑞安航空的乘客花费八个小时飞往英国并返回西班牙
summary: Passengers aboard a Ryanair Boeing 737-800 spent almost eight hours travelling across Europe on Saturday, 24 October, only to return to their original departure airport in Spain. Flight FR2954, registration 9H-QDK, was scheduled to fly from Alicante to Cornwal
summary_zh: 10 月 24 日星期六，乘坐瑞安航空波音 737-800 的乘客花了近 8 个小时穿越欧洲，最后才返回原来的位置
body_en: Ryanair passengers spend eight hours flying to England and back to Spain - Aviation24.be

Passengers aboard a Ryanair Boeing 737-800 spent almost eight hours travelling across Europe on Saturday, 24 October, only to return to their original departure airport in Spain. Flight FR2954, registration 9H-QDK, was scheduled to fly from Alicante to Cornwall Newquay Airport, but severe weather associated with Storm Austen prevented the aircraft from landing in southwest England.

The aircraft departed Alicante at around 18:36 local time, approximately an hour behind schedule. After approaching Newquay, the crew abandoned the landing due to strong winds and diverted to Dublin, where the aircraft landed at around 20:52 local time. Passengers remained on board while Ryanair arranged a revised plan. At around 22:34, the aircraft departed Dublin as flight FR2955, bound for Bristol, from where passengers were expected to continue their journey to Cornwall by bus.

However, weather conditions also prevented the aircraft from landing at Bristol. The crew subsequently turned back towards Alicante, where the Boeing 737 landed at approximately 02:15 on Sunday, 25 October. The aircraft had travelled between Spain, Ireland and England without delivering its passengers to their intended destination. According to media reports, passengers were accommodated in a hotel following their return to Spain.
The aircraft’s return to Alicante also allowed Ryanair to reposition it at its operating base ahead of subsequent scheduled services.
Sources: PYOK, One Mile at a Time, aeroTELEGRAPH and flight-tracking data.

body_zh: 瑞安航空的乘客花费八个小时飞往英国并返回西班牙 - Aviation24.be
10 月 24 日星期六，瑞安航空波音 737-800 飞机上的乘客花了近 8 个小时穿越欧洲，最后才返回原来的出发地西班牙机场。注册号为 9H-QDK 的 FR2954 航班原定从阿利坎特飞往康沃尔纽基机场，但奥斯汀风暴带来的恶劣天气阻止了飞机在英格兰西南部降落。
飞机于当地时间18点36分左右从阿利坎特起飞，比原计划晚了大约一个小时。接近纽基后，机组人员因强风放弃着陆，改飞都柏林，飞机于当地时间20时52分左右降落在都柏林。瑞安航空安排修订计划时，乘客仍留在飞机上。 22点34分左右，这架飞机搭乘FR2955航班从都柏林出发，飞往布里斯托尔，预计乘客将从那里乘坐巴士继续前往康沃尔郡。
然而，天气状况也导致飞机未能在布里斯托尔降落。机组人员随后返回阿利坎特，这架波音 737 于 10 月 25 日星期日凌晨 02:15 左右降落在阿利坎特。这架飞机在西班牙、爱尔兰和英格兰之间飞行，但没有将乘客运送到预定目的地。据媒体报道，乘客返回西班牙后被安置在一家酒店。
这架飞机返回阿利坎特也使得瑞安航空能够在随后的定期航班之前将其重新安置在其运营基地。

title_en: Jet2 Boeing 737 veers onto grass during landing at Birmingham Airport
title_zh: Jet2 波音 737 在伯明翰机场降落时转向草地
summary: A Jet2 Boeing 737-800 briefly veered off the runway while landing at Birmingham Airport, United Kingdom on Sunday, 25 October, amid strong winds associated with Storm Boelo. Flight LS1310, registration G-JZHE, was arriving from Venice Marco Polo Airport when i
summary_zh: 10 月 25 日星期日，一架 Jet2 波音 737-800 飞机在强风中在英国伯明翰机场降落时短暂偏离跑道。
body_en: Jet2 Boeing 737 veers onto grass during landing at Birmingham Airport - Aviation24.be

A Jet2 Boeing 737-800 briefly veered off the runway while landing at Birmingham Airport, United Kingdom on Sunday, 25 October, amid strong winds associated with Storm Boelo. Flight LS1310, registration G-JZHE, was arriving from Venice Marco Polo Airport when it landed on Runway 33 at approximately 14:19 local time.

Footage circulating on social media (see below) shows the aircraft moving towards the left edge of the runway after touchdown, with its left main landing gear crossing onto the grass before the aircraft returned to the paved surface. The flight was operating under the callsign EXS4FX.

Jet2 confirmed that the aircraft temporarily moved off the runway due to exceptional weather conditions caused by Storm Boelo. The aircraft returned to the runway and taxied to its stand, where all passengers disembarked normally. No injuries were reported. The precise circumstances of the incident and any possible aircraft damage have not been confirmed.
WATCH: Another angle of yesterday’s Jet2 Boeing 737-800 (G-JZHE), operating flight LS1310 from Venice, shows the moment it veered off the runway at Birmingham Airport, UK.
Crosswind landings require precise control inputs, especially during the flare and the transition to ground roll.

During the flare, the pilot uses the rudder to align the aircraft’s nose with the runway while applying opposite aileron as needed to prevent the upwind wing from lifting. In this case, right rudder would be required if the aircraft needed to yaw to the right to align with the runway.

Timing is critical. Correcting too early or using the wrong combination of rudder and aileron can cause lateral drift. At touchdown, the aircraft should be aligned as closely as practicable with the runway centerline.

Once on the ground, rudder effectiveness decreases as speed reduces. Nose-wheel steering, linked to the rudder pedals on the 737, helps maintain directional control during the rollout. However, strong crosswinds and sudden gusts can make the aircraft difficult to keep aligned.
Birmingham Airport (BHX) is known for challenging crosswind conditions, and the recent Storm Boelo and Austen affecting the UK made these conditions even more demanding.

Something worth noting: if the pilot transitions from the rudder pedals to the toe brakes and releases some right-rudder input before directional control is fully established, that could affect the aircraft’s alignment. However, the footage alone is not enough to confirm the exact control inputs or establish the cause of the runway excursion.

Had the aircraft struck the elevated runway edge lights or other hard objects, the landing gear tire could have burst immediately! I am sure there are deep cuts on the left main gear tire and some flat spots due to excessive braking.

After such an incident, the crew normally reports the occurrence through the operator’s safety reporting system and files an Air Safety Report. The aircraft would also require an appropriate inspection before returning to service, with the extent of the checks determined by the event and the applicable maintenance procedures. The CAA will be involved locally.

I have seen instances where, after an incident, pilots simply park the aircraft at the gate and leave without filing a report to cover themselves, which is bad practice. During inspection, maintenance finds out, and then they are in trouble.
